Plot one cell type's proportion by outcome

Source: R/plotting.R
plotProportionBoxplot.Rd

Shows, for one cell type (or group), each image's proportion measured with the original labels (unweighted) and with the bootstrap confidence weights (weighted), for each level of the outcome. For the results of runProportionsPipeline() the proportion is of all cells in the image; for the results of runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline() it is of the cells of the parent group. Each point is one image.

Usage

plotProportionBoxplot(results, cellType, spe, outcomeCol)

Arguments

results

Output of runProportionsPipeline() or runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline().

cellType

The cell type to show: one of the cellType values in results$proportions. For runProportionsPipeline() results this can also be one of the bootstrapped groups.

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. a SpatialExperiment) with imageID and the outcome in colData.

outcomeCol

Name of the outcome column in colData(spe).

Value

An interactive plot, a girafe widget that needs the ggiraph package.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
res = runProportionsPipeline(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
    outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
#> Computing unweighted proportions once (shared across all subtypes)...
#> Computing weighted proportions...
#> Fitting weighted models...
rel = runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree,
    lungConfList, outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
#> Computing proportions relative to parent...
#> Fitting unweighted models...
#> Fitting weighted models...
if (requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
    plotProportionBoxplot(res, "Arteriole", lungSubset, "disease_status")
    plotProportionBoxplot(rel, "Arteriole", lungSubset, "disease_status")
}
